pages.text: Eat the same meal day after day and it stops doing much for you. Each repeat fills you a little less, down to almost nothing.

Keep a few dishes in rotation and you'll hardly notice. A food's tooltip shows how tired of it you are. The $(l:world/food_health#food_history_book)Food History Book$(/l) remembers what you've eaten, and a $(l:world/food_health#wicker_basket)Wicker Basket$(/l) feeds you from whatever you've packed.$(br2)Golden apples, kelp, honey and chorus fruit never grow stale.
Holds 9 stacks of food. Right-click to eat the best one; sneak + right-click to open.
Shows every food you have eaten.
